## Houston 0.6.17

### Houston on your phone

- **Move around Houston on your phone with a proper navigation bar**, a More menu, and Teams as its own home.
- **See your agents and their tasks in lists built for small screens**, instead of a sideways board.

### Calmer, more honest messages

- **Everyday moments no longer look like failures**, so a waking agent, an expired sign-in link, or a permission you do not have shows a clear notice instead of a red error.

### Fixes and polish

- **The integrations catalog now shows every available app**, instead of stopping partway through the list.
- **Using Houston in a translated browser page no longer breaks the screen.**
- **Model choices behave**, so Houston offers a model your connected provider can actually run, and a Claude subscription stays connected on self-hosted setups.
- Additional reliability improvements under the hood.
